sources.text: serena a Oe Prt | FORWPRD NPCI/UPI/OC-186A/2026-27 10" September 2026 To, Members and UPI Application Providers — Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Subject: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS) With reference to UPI Operating Circular NPCI/UPI/OC-186/2023-24 dated 19° December 2023, UPI Tap & Pay through Near Field Communication (NFC) on QR was introduced as an additional mode for initiating UPI transactions. In addition to QR, UPI Tap & Pay shall now be extended to Point of Sale (PoS) terminals enabling Users to make contactless (NFC-based) UPI! payments by unlocking their mobile device and tapping it on the PoS terminal.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: Payee PSP 1. Payee PSP shall enable UPI Tap & Pay only on NFC-enabled PoS terminals that are certified in accordance with the Payment Card Industry PIN Transaction Security / Contactless Payments on Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) devices (PCI PTS / CPOC) standards.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 4. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that settlement, reconciliation, dispute management, and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for UPI Tap & Pay transactions are carried out in accordance with the extant UPI guidelines as per applicability.

sources.text: 3. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that per transaction limit is capped at ₹5000, up to which additional factor of authentication shall not be required.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

August 2024 To, All Members - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of “UPI Circle” —- Delegated Payments for secondary users UPI has emerged as a preferred mode of payment for users. UPI has created a seamless digital experience to enable users to transact via their mobile devices. There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Steering Committee meeting held on 3% August 2023 had endorsed the introduction of “UPI Circle - Delegate Payments”. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. Primary user can authorize a trusted secondary user for performing transactions within the security protocols/ limits. sources.text: aRearT wskr wrart Pere NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA NPCI /UPI/OC No.201/2024-25 13!" August 2024 To, All Members - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of “UPI Circle” —- Delegated Payments for secondary users UPI has emerged as a preferred mode of payment for users. UPI has created a seamless digital experience to enable users to transact via their mobile devices. There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Steering Committee meeting held on 3% August 2023 had endorsed the introduction of “UPI Circle - Delegate Payments”. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. Primary user can authorize a trusted secondary user for performing transactions within the security protocols/ limits. Full Delegation — Primary user authorizes a secondary user to initiate and complete UPI transactions as per defined spend limits Partial Delegation — Primary user authorizes initiation of payment requests from secondary users, Primary user shall complete UP! transaction with
sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

UPI has created a seamless digital experience to enable users to transact via their mobile devices. There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Steering Committee meeting held on 3% August 2023 had endorsed the introduction of “UPI Circle - Delegate Payments”. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. Primary user can authorize a trusted secondary user for performing transactions within the security protocols/ limits. Full Delegation — Primary user authorizes a secondary user to initiate and complete UPI transactions as per defined spend limits Partial Delegation — Primary user authorizes initiation of payment requests from secondary users, Primary user shall complete UP! transaction with
sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

August 2024 To, All Members - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of “UPI Circle” —- Delegated Payments for secondary users UPI has emerged as a preferred mode of payment for users. UPI has created a seamless digital experience to enable users to transact via their mobile devices. There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Steering Committee meeting held on 3% August 2023 had endorsed the introduction of “UPI Circle - Delegate Payments”. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. Primary user can authorize a trusted secondary user for performing transactions within the security protocols/ limits. Under Full Delegation Framework, the Primary User authorizes the Secondary User to initiate and complete UPI transactions as per defined monthly spend limits. For Full Delegation Framework, the following additional guidelines need to be adhered to during the linking process by the Primary User for the Secondary User:

sources.text: 4. Members live on UPI Circle feature to make necessary changes by 31% August 2025. sources.text: serena a Oe Prt | FORWPRD NPCI/UPI/OC-186A/2026-27 10" September 2026 To, Members and UPI Application Providers — Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Subject: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS) With reference to UPI Operating Circular NPCI/UPI/OC-186/2023-24 dated 19° December 2023, UPI Tap & Pay through Near Field Communication (NFC) on QR was introduced as an additional mode for initiating UPI transactions. In addition to QR, UPI Tap & Pay shall now be extended to Point of Sale (PoS) terminals enabling Users to make contactless (NFC-based) UPI! payments by unlocking their mobile device and tapping it on the PoS terminal.

sources.text: Key Guidelines 1. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UPI Tap & Pay transactions on PoS terminals are accepted only for Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: Payee PSP 1. Payee PSP shall enable UPI Tap & Pay only on NFC-enabled PoS terminals that are certified in accordance with the Payment Card Industry PIN Transaction Security / Contactless Payments on Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) devices (PCI PTS / CPOC) standards.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: UPI Application Provider 1. UP! Application Providers / PSP Banks shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained after each device binding operation before allowing further transactions using UPI! Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: Remitter Bank 1. Remitter Bank shall validate the User’s account for UPI Tap & Pay feature enablement status before processing each transaction. Yours sincerely, SD/- Sourabh Tomar Deputy Chief — UPI Product Page 2 of 2
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 2. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained for enabling UPI Tap & Pay feature, with Users having the ability to opt out at any time.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 2. Payee PSP shall integrate the Point-of-Sale Common Library for UPI (PoS CL) at the PoS terminal and complete the integration on all the PoS terminals under its acquiring network. Page 1 of 2 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 O51-

sources.text: 2. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that device lock is enabled as a prerequisite for activating UP! Tap & Pay. Further, the device shall be in an unlocked state at the time of initiating a UP! Tap & Pay transaction.

sources.text: 3. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that per transaction limit is capped at ₹5000, up to which additional factor of authentication shall not be required.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 3. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UP! Tap & Pay is made available through a dedicated call-to- action. The functionality shall be presented as a standalone feature and shall not be embedded within any other service, feature, or menu category.

sources.text: 4. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that settlement, reconciliation, dispute management, and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for UPI Tap & Pay transactions are carried out in accordance with the extant UPI guidelines as per applicability.

sources.text: 5. Members shall be guided by RBI guidelines on ‘Harmonization of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorized Payment Systems’ dated September 20, 2019, as amended from time to time.

sources.text: NZE) NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA NPCI/UPI/OC No.186/2023-24 19th December 2023 To, All Members, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of UP] TAP & PAY mode of payments In addition to the existing modes (Scan & Pay, Pay to Contact, UPI Number, etc.) of UPI Payments, “UPI Tap & Pay” is the new mode introduced for UP] transactions. Following is the construct for UPI Tap & Pay transactions:
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 1. UPI APPs shall ensure to provide the Tap & Pay mode of payment only through mobiles devices having NFC capability.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. UPI APPs shall take permission from the customer to enable NFC for Tap & Pay transactions.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 3. UPI Apps shall provide separate call to action button for Tap & Pay mode on the homepage.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 4. On Tap, the transaction amount of Rs.500 and less will be processed through UP! LITE account, if enabled by the user, if not, then the transaction shall be processed with UPI PIN. UPI APPs are recommended to have the App passcode, biometrics or pattern based lock in case of UPI LITE.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 5. On Tap, the transaction amount more than Rs.500 will need UP! PIN and will be processed online.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 6. Members shall ensure to comply with the NPCI brand guidelines updated on NPCI website for UPI Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 7. UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment shall be available on mobile devices with both android/ ios operating systems.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 8. Initiation mode ‘06’ shall be used for UPI Tap & Pay transactions. All UP] Apps and banks shall ensure to process TAP & Pay transactions with initiation mode 06.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 9. Acquiring banks shall ensure that NFC tags used inside the UPI Smart QRs/ Tags are NFC forum certified (Type 2) and non-rewritable post personalisation. Acquiring banks shall be liable for the loss occurred due to tampering, if any. Acquiring banks shall perform the periodic checks of the UPI Smart QRs installed at the merchants and ensure replacement, if required. 1OO1A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051. T: +91 22 40009100 F: +91 22 40009101 contact@npci.org.in www.npci.org.in CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 10. Acquiring banks shall ensure to procure the NFC Tags from NPC! empanelied vendors as communicated via circular no. NPCI/2020-21/NETC/002 and NPCI/2022- 23/RuPay/013 and updated from time to time.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 11. UPI QR specifications shall be embedded inside the UP! Smart Tag (NFC Tag), or in the paper-based UP] Smart QR (NFC QR). The details of the same are part of UPI Tap & Pay product kit. 12, Transactions performed using UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment will follow the existing dispute management process. With reference to the above, UPI Member are requested to take note and Go-live on mentioned functionality by 31st January’ 2024. Yours Sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

August 2024 To, All Members - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of “UPI Circle” —- Delegated Payments for secondary users UPI has emerged as a preferred mode of payment for users. UPI has created a seamless digital experience to enable users to transact via their mobile devices. There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Steering Committee meeting held on 3% August 2023 had endorsed the introduction of “UPI Circle - Delegate Payments”. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. Primary user can authorize a trusted secondary user for performing transactions within the security protocols/ limits. Full Delegation — Primary user authorizes a secondary user to initiate and complete UPI transactions as per defined spend limits Partial Delegation — Primary user authorizes initiation of payment requests from secondary users, Primary user shall complete UP! transaction with

sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.text: 8. Existing UPI limits shall be applicable in case of partial delegation

sources.text: 9. Members shall ensure that during the cooling period — first 24 hours, a daily transaction limit of ₹5000 shall be prescribed after successful linking of primary and their secondary user for both full and partial delegation

sources.text: 10. Members shall ensure that the Primary user have visibility of transactions performed by secondary users on their UPI App and bank account statement
sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.text: 11. Members shail adhere to RBI guidelines on “Harmonization of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorised Payment Systems” dated September 20, 2019, as amended from time to time
sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.text: 12. Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) functionality shall be available for UPI transactions
sources.title: Introduction of “UPI Circle” – Delegated Payments for secondary users

sources.text: aR asset apart rrr NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA NPCI/UPI/OC/201A/2025-26 8" July 2025 To, UPI Member Banks, PSP’s and Third-Party App Providers Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Addendum to NPCI/UPI/2024-25/0C201 - Introduction of “UPI Circle” - Delegated Payments for secondary users — Full Delegation Additional Requirements With reference to UPI operating circular NPCI/UPI/2024-25/0C201 dated 13'" August 2024, NPCI has introduced “UPI Circle - Delegated Payments for secondary users”. Under Full Delegation Framework, the Primary User authorizes the Secondary User to initiate and complete UPI transactions as per defined monthly spend limits. For Full Delegation Framework, the following additional guidelines need to be adhered to during the linking process by the Primary User for the Secondary User:
sources.title: Introduction of UPI Circle – Delegated Payments for secondary users – Full Delegation Additional Requirements

sources.text: 1. Primary User via the Primary Payer PSP shall identify that the Secondary User to whom the delegation is being provided is from specific segments — viz., a family member (Child/ Parent/ Spouse/ Sibling/ Other Family Member) or Domestic or Small Business Employee
sources.title: Introduction of UPI Circle – Delegated Payments for secondary users – Full Delegation Additional Requirements

sources.text: 2. Primary Payer PSP shall share additional details (Document Type and Document ID number) of the Secondary User to the Secondary Payer PSP and the Issuer Bank
sources.title: Introduction of UPI Circle – Delegated Payments for secondary users – Full Delegation Additional Requirements

sources.text: 3. Issuer Bank of the Primary User shall identify the Secondary User at the time of delegation by way of name, mobile number and ID number of an Officially Valid Document as defined under Master Direction Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016 (as updated from time to time)
sources.title: Introduction of UPI Circle – Delegated Payments for secondary users – Full Delegation Additional Requirements

sources.text: 4. Secondary Payer PSP shall take explicit consent from Secondary User on the additional details (Document Type and Document ID number) before accepting the Full Delegation request from the Primary User Members are advised to refer to UPI Circle Procedural Guidelines for detailed information updated from time to time along with existing regulatory and legal framework. Members live on UPI Circle feature to make necessary changes by 31% August 2025. Yours Sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051. T: +91 22 40009100 F: +91 22 40009101 contact@npci.org.in www.npci.org.in CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067

sources.text: NPCIUPVOC-207/2024-25 23" September 2024 To, Members - Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Members — NETC FASTag Members — RuPay Auto-replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI Autopay Dear Madam / Sir, UPI Autopay covers recurring needs such as recurring bill payments, OTT subscriptions, loan EMI payments, and other scenarios where periodicity of payment is well-defined. To further enhance customer experience in various use cases which are recurring in nature but without any fixed periodicity,
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: 1. Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced to facilitate e-mandate framework for auto-replenishment of balances in NETC FASTag and RuPay National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) in “Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies” dated 07" June 2024.
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: 2. Further, it was directed:
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: a) To include auto-replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC, as and when the balance falls below a threshold set by the customer, under the e- mandate framework.
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: b) Exemption from 24-Hours prior Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) for auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC. in the Circular RBI/2024-25/64 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S528/02-14-003/2024-25 issued by Reserve Bank of India (RBI), dated 22" August 2024
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: 3. All other instructions provided under the e-mandate framework shall continue to remain applicable In line with the above communications, the auto-replenishment of NETC FASTag (MCC 4784) and RuPay NCMC (MCC 7412) is permitted without 24-hrs Pre-Debited Notification under JOO1A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051. T: +91 22 40009100 F: +91 22 40009101 www.npci.org.in CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067 contact@npci.org.in
sources.title: Auto- replenishment of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC with UPI AutoPay

sources.text: ardier wesfer aprart frre NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA UPI Autopay framework. Ail UP] Members shall remove the PDN validation for any UPI Autopay execution only for the mentioned MCCs. NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC Issuer Banks to ensure that the auto-replenishment done under exception of Pre-Debit Notification as per the said guidelines shall be used only for the intended purposes of NETC FASTag and RuPay NCMC only. All UPI remitter banks, Payer PSP Banks, and concerned ecosystem stakeholders shall implement the same with immediate effect. This directive must be communicated to all relevant stakeholders for appropriate actions. Thanking You, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Producis

sources.text: NZE) NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA NPCI/UPI/OC No.186/2023-24 19th December 2023 To, All Members, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of UP] TAP & PAY mode of payments In addition to the existing modes (Scan & Pay, Pay to Contact, UPI Number, etc.) of UPI Payments, “UPI Tap & Pay” is the new mode introduced for UP] transactions. Following is the construct for UPI Tap & Pay transactions:
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: serena a Oe Prt | FORWPRD NPCI/UPI/OC-186A/2026-27 10" September 2026 To, Members and UPI Application Providers — Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Subject: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS) With reference to UPI Operating Circular NPCI/UPI/OC-186/2023-24 dated 19° December 2023, UPI Tap & Pay through Near Field Communication (NFC) on QR was introduced as an additional mode for initiating UPI transactions. In addition to QR, UPI Tap & Pay shall now be extended to Point of Sale (PoS) terminals enabling Users to make contactless (NFC-based) UPI! payments by unlocking their mobile device and tapping it on the PoS terminal.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 1. UPI APPs shall ensure to provide the Tap & Pay mode of payment only through mobiles devices having NFC capability.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Key Guidelines 1. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UPI Tap & Pay transactions on PoS terminals are accepted only for Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 2. UPI APPs shall take permission from the customer to enable NFC for Tap & Pay transactions.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Payee PSP 1. Payee PSP shall enable UPI Tap & Pay only on NFC-enabled PoS terminals that are certified in accordance with the Payment Card Industry PIN Transaction Security / Contactless Payments on Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) devices (PCI PTS / CPOC) standards.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 3. UPI Apps shall provide separate call to action button for Tap & Pay mode on the homepage.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: UPI Application Provider 1. UP! Application Providers / PSP Banks shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained after each device binding operation before allowing further transactions using UPI! Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 4. On Tap, the transaction amount of Rs.500 and less will be processed through UP! LITE account, if enabled by the user, if not, then the transaction shall be processed with UPI PIN. UPI APPs are recommended to have the App passcode, biometrics or pattern based lock in case of UPI LITE.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Remitter Bank 1. Remitter Bank shall validate the User’s account for UPI Tap & Pay feature enablement status before processing each transaction. Further, Members & UPI Application Providers shall be consulted to provide option to Users to set their own transaction limits within the aforesaid ceiling of ₹5000. Yours sincerely, SD/- Sourabh Tomar Deputy Chief — UPI Product Page 2 of 2
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 5. On Tap, the transaction amount more than Rs.500 will need UP! PIN and will be processed online.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained for enabling UPI Tap & Pay feature, with Users having the ability to opt out at any time.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 6. Members shall ensure to comply with the NPCI brand guidelines updated on NPCI website for UPI Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. Payee PSP shall integrate the Point-of-Sale Common Library for UPI (PoS CL) at the PoS terminal and complete the integration on all the PoS terminals under its acquiring network. Page 1 of 2 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 O51-
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 7. UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment shall be available on mobile devices with both android/ ios operating systems.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that device lock is enabled as a prerequisite for activating UP! Tap & Pay. Further, the device shall be in an unlocked state at the time of initiating a UP! Tap & Pay transaction.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 8. Initiation mode ‘06’ shall be used for UPI Tap & Pay transactions. All UP] Apps and banks shall ensure to process TAP & Pay transactions with initiation mode 06.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 3. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that per transaction limit is capped at ₹5000, up to which additional factor of authentication shall not be required.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 9. Acquiring banks shall ensure that NFC tags used inside the UPI Smart QRs/ Tags are NFC forum certified (Type 2) and non-rewritable post personalisation. Acquiring banks shall be liable for the loss occurred due to tampering, if any. Acquiring banks shall perform the periodic checks of the UPI Smart QRs installed at the merchants and ensure replacement, if required. 1OO1A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051. T: +91 22 40009100 F: +91 22 40009101 contact@npci.org.in www.npci.org.in CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: sero na EE ETE | FORWARD
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 10. Acquiring banks shall ensure to procure the NFC Tags from NPC! empanelied vendors as communicated via circular no. NPCI/2020-21/NETC/002 and NPCI/2022- 23/RuPay/013 and updated from time to time.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 3. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UP! Tap & Pay is made available through a dedicated call-to- action. The functionality shall be presented as a standalone feature and shall not be embedded within any other service, feature, or menu category.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 11. UPI QR specifications shall be embedded inside the UP! Smart Tag (NFC Tag), or in the paper-based UP] Smart QR (NFC QR). The details of the same are part of UPI Tap & Pay product kit. 12, Transactions performed using UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment will follow the existing dispute management process. With reference to the above, UPI Member are requested to take note and Go-live on mentioned functionality by 31st January’ 2024. Yours Sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 4. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that settlement, reconciliation, dispute management, and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for UPI Tap & Pay transactions are carried out in accordance with the extant UPI guidelines as per applicability.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 5. Members shall be guided by RBI guidelines on ‘Harmonization of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorized Payment Systems’ dated September 20, 2019, as amended from time to time.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 6. Members and UPI Application Providers shall refer to the applicable UP! Tap & Pay Feature Document, Technical Specifications and other instructions issued by NPCI from time to time for detailed functional, technical and operational requirements.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

There are users who are still dependent on cash for their daily payment needs because they do not manage their own money through their own account. With the objective of addressing these unmet needs, introduce “UPI Circle” is introduced, wherein UPI users can delegate to their trusted secondary users for making payments. UPI Circle is a feature where a UPI user acts as a primary to link with their trusted secondary users on their UPI App for either partial or full delegation. sources.text: NZE) NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA NPCI/UPI/OC No.186/2023-24 19th December 2023 To, All Members, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of UP] TAP & PAY mode of payments In addition to the existing modes (Scan & Pay, Pay to Contact, UPI Number, etc.) of UPI Payments, “UPI Tap & Pay” is the new mode introduced for UP] transactions. Following is the construct for UPI Tap & Pay transactions:
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: serena a Oe Prt | FORWPRD NPCI/UPI/OC-186A/2026-27 10" September 2026 To, Members and UPI Application Providers — Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Subject: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS) With reference to UPI Operating Circular NPCI/UPI/OC-186/2023-24 dated 19° December 2023, UPI Tap & Pay through Near Field Communication (NFC) on QR was introduced as an additional mode for initiating UPI transactions. In addition to QR, UPI Tap & Pay shall now be extended to Point of Sale (PoS) terminals enabling Users to make contactless (NFC-based) UPI! payments by unlocking their mobile device and tapping it on the PoS terminal.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 1. UPI APPs shall ensure to provide the Tap & Pay mode of payment only through mobiles devices having NFC capability.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Key Guidelines 1. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UPI Tap & Pay transactions on PoS terminals are accepted only for Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 2. UPI APPs shall take permission from the customer to enable NFC for Tap & Pay transactions.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Payee PSP 1. Payee PSP shall enable UPI Tap & Pay only on NFC-enabled PoS terminals that are certified in accordance with the Payment Card Industry PIN Transaction Security / Contactless Payments on Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) devices (PCI PTS / CPOC) standards.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 3. UPI Apps shall provide separate call to action button for Tap & Pay mode on the homepage.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: UPI Application Provider 1. UP! Application Providers / PSP Banks shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained after each device binding operation before allowing further transactions using UPI! Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 4. On Tap, the transaction amount of Rs.500 and less will be processed through UP! LITE account, if enabled by the user, if not, then the transaction shall be processed with UPI PIN. UPI APPs are recommended to have the App passcode, biometrics or pattern based lock in case of UPI LITE.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: Remitter Bank 1. Remitter Bank shall validate the User’s account for UPI Tap & Pay feature enablement status before processing each transaction. Further, Members & UPI Application Providers shall be consulted to provide option to Users to set their own transaction limits within the aforesaid ceiling of ₹5000. Yours sincerely, SD/- Sourabh Tomar Deputy Chief — UPI Product Page 2 of 2
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 5. On Tap, the transaction amount more than Rs.500 will need UP! PIN and will be processed online.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure explicit User consent is obtained for enabling UPI Tap & Pay feature, with Users having the ability to opt out at any time.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 6. Members shall ensure to comply with the NPCI brand guidelines updated on NPCI website for UPI Tap & Pay.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. Payee PSP shall integrate the Point-of-Sale Common Library for UPI (PoS CL) at the PoS terminal and complete the integration on all the PoS terminals under its acquiring network. Page 1 of 2 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 O51-
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 7. UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment shall be available on mobile devices with both android/ ios operating systems.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 2. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that device lock is enabled as a prerequisite for activating UP! Tap & Pay. Further, the device shall be in an unlocked state at the time of initiating a UP! Tap & Pay transaction.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 8. Initiation mode ‘06’ shall be used for UPI Tap & Pay transactions. All UP] Apps and banks shall ensure to process TAP & Pay transactions with initiation mode 06.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 3. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that per transaction limit is capped at ₹5000, up to which additional factor of authentication shall not be required.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 9. Acquiring banks shall ensure that NFC tags used inside the UPI Smart QRs/ Tags are NFC forum certified (Type 2) and non-rewritable post personalisation. Acquiring banks shall be liable for the loss occurred due to tampering, if any. Acquiring banks shall perform the periodic checks of the UPI Smart QRs installed at the merchants and ensure replacement, if required. 1OO1A, The Capital, B Wing, 10" Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051. T: +91 22 40009100 F: +91 22 40009101 contact@npci.org.in www.npci.org.in CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 10. Acquiring banks shall ensure to procure the NFC Tags from NPC! empanelied vendors as communicated via circular no. NPCI/2020-21/NETC/002 and NPCI/2022- 23/RuPay/013 and updated from time to time.
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 3. UPI Application Providers shall ensure that UP! Tap & Pay is made available through a dedicated call-to- action. The functionality shall be presented as a standalone feature and shall not be embedded within any other service, feature, or menu category.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 11. UPI QR specifications shall be embedded inside the UP! Smart Tag (NFC Tag), or in the paper-based UP] Smart QR (NFC QR). The details of the same are part of UPI Tap & Pay product kit. 12, Transactions performed using UPI Tap & Pay mode of payment will follow the existing dispute management process. With reference to the above, UPI Member are requested to take note and Go-live on mentioned functionality by 31st January’ 2024. Yours Sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products
sources.title: Introduction of UPI TAP & PAY mode of Payments

sources.text: 4. Members and UPI Application Providers shall ensure that settlement, reconciliation, dispute management, and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for UPI Tap & Pay transactions are carried out in accordance with the extant UPI guidelines as per applicability.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 5. Members shall be guided by RBI guidelines on ‘Harmonization of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorized Payment Systems’ dated September 20, 2019, as amended from time to time.
sources.title: Enhancement - UPI Tap & Pay on Point of Sale (PoS)

sources.text: 6. Members and UPI Application Providers shall refer to the applicable UP! Tap & Pay Feature Document, Technical Specifications and other instructions issued by NPCI from time to time for detailed functional, technical and operational requirements.

sources.text: 1001A, B wing, 10th Floor, The Capital, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400 051 CIN: U74990MH2008NPL189067 Circular: NPCI/2017-18/PD/004 August 10, 2017 To, All RuPay Acquiring Member Banks Integration of Bharat QR with UPI credentials Dear All, As per the direction received from Reserve Bank of India in October 2016, NPCI and International card schemes jointly worked towards implementing common interoperable QR code based card payment solution namely “Bharat QR”. Bharat QR was launched on 20th February, 2017. Further, under the guidance of Indian Bank Association (IBA), NPCI had facilitated to integrate UPI credentials (Virtual Payment Address (VPA), Account + IFSC & Aadhaar number) as a part of Bharat QR standards. In this regard, NPCI had released technical specifications (Merchant QR Code Specification V 4.0) to integrate UPI credentials in Bharat QR to all RuPay acquiring member banks on 18th May, 2017. It may be noted that RuPay acquiring member banks have already started the development to integrate UPI credentials with Bharat QR and various banks are under certification with NPCI. We request all RuPay acquiring member banks to comply with Merchant QR Code Specifications V 4.0 and ensure that all Bharat QR deployed post 15th Sep 2017 should contain UPI credentials. Yours truly, Dilip Asbe Chief Operating Officer

sources.text: fs Conroe =) NPCI/UPI/OC no.199/2024-25 25" June 2024 To, All Members, UPI (Unified Payment Interface) Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Update to NPCI CL version 1.8 or above UPI has become a preferred digital payment mode across the country. It provides ease of use, convenience and superior user experience with security and interoperability. To ensure the safety and security of the UPI systems, NPCI constantly reviews the security checks of all components in the UPI ecosystem and regularly upgrades them to address evolving threats in cyber landscape. There are security checks implemented as part of the code embedded in the Common Library (CL) along with the feature release to enhance user experience on UPI platforms. Integration of latest versions of CL is important to ensure enhanced security and safety in UPI ecosystem. With this objective, NPCI will be retiring the support for CL prior to Version 1.8 after 30% September 2024. To ensure compliance PSP Banks shall certify and enable CL 1.8 or above and their respective UPI Apps shall integrate the latest version of CL within their application, on or before 30% September 2024. Members are requested to take note of this compliance and communicate it to relevant stakeholders and their respective partners. Yours sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10* Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex,

With this objective, NPCI will be retiring the support for CL prior to Version 1.8 after 30% September 2024. To ensure compliance PSP Banks shall certify and enable CL 1.8 or above and their respective UPI Apps shall integrate the latest version of CL within their application, on or before 30% September 2024. Members are requested to take note of this compliance and communicate it to relevant stakeholders and their respective partners. Yours sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Products 1001A, The Capital, B Wing, 10* Floor, Bandra Kurla Complex,
